page: Hono Stacks for full-stack application development: makes easy things easy, hard things easy. Not just JSON APIs but full-stack apps including REST APIs and client. RPC feature shares API specs with type-safe generated client using hc. Stack components: Hono (API server), Zod (validator), Zod Validator Middleware, hc (HTTP client). Enables type-safe API calls from client with InferResponseType, InferRequestType.

sections.manifest: RPC feature: Hono Stack for type-safe full-stack applications. Client generated by hc reads API spec and accesses endpoints with type safety.
Write API: Hono app with GET /hello endpoint returning JSON with message field.
Validation with Zod: use zValidator middleware targeting 'query' with Zod schema. Extract validated query param 'name' from c.req.valid('query'). Return JSON response using validated value.
Sharing types: export endpoint type as AppType from route or app using typeof. Required: all methods chained, endpoint/app type inferred from declared variable. Follow RPC best practices.

Client implementation: create client with hc<AppType>('/api'). Call endpoints like client.hello.$get() with query parameters. Response is fetch API compatible. json() returns typed data with autocomplete.

React full-stack example: Cloudflare Workers app with Hono API server, React + React Query client. POST /todo creates todos, GET /todo retrieves. useQuery hook for fetching, useMutation for POST. InferResponseType/InferRequestType for typing mutations. Client code shows form input and todo list rendering.
